text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —...Ghaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
(So... ex... hausting...!
I-I can't. No more. It's over. Over—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: “—Leave it to me, Helios! From here on, as your BFF, I'll...!!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna pull off a miraculous runaway lead!!
Just you waaaaatch—!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Blow them awaaaayyyy!!!!
Palmeeeeer-channnnnnnnnnnnnn!!" chariot-like roar

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Yesssssss!
I wonnnnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeehhhhh!?!?
Palmer won!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*...!
Pal-Palmer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios, I did it!!
I... I won! I actually won!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chiiiin!!
Congrats~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing!
Palmer-chin, you were the biggest party animal today!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right?☆
Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"We made our miracle happen!
Super hyped! Whoo!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, Palm-chin!!
I... wasn't hyped at all except at the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, seriously!
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: My head was just totally full of thoughts like making a miracle happen for the two of them, or that I had to win...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Until you hyped me up, Palmer-chin,
running wasn't any fun at all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I can't do this.
Running for someone else's sake is way too exhausting!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Nicely done, Palmer-chin!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Well, it's pretty much for my own sake anyway!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "Still! Ruby and the others have been doing this all along, haven't they?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
That's why I've already figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—You and I have
completely different ways of seeing the world.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...I figured it out.
Milady—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, wait, what?? Palmer winning...
Talk about the upset of the century, right!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... it's a miracle.
I wonder if something happened to Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Me too! I won't back down either!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Helios really gave Palmer
a lot of strength, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Helios... this is your—
this is the miracle all of you created.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. Helios-san has a way of... pulling others along and pushing things forward."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Will I... be able to run again too?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because... I still haven't repaid everyone
for everything they've done for me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to make another miracle happen too,
and run for everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Because I'm the one who's the Miracle!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You can do it.
If it's you... I know you can run again.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I must crawl out of the darkness too.
And from here, achieve the ultimate brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, a result worthy of our family name.
For everyone's sake...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Shall we make... another promise?
This time—from me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
――Haha...
Too true.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So that's why Milady...
cracks up laughing at "that," huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Btw, is Ruby actually cracking a huge smile!?
Whoa, amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios!
It's totally our power, we did it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Palmer-chin,
the lady's smile is super cute, isn't it!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
As the ogre!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
It made my heart go totally thump... thump...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Be struck by love...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait,
what's wrong!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo smiled.
My heart totally skipped a beat. But...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
She's not like me.
Ojo doesn't laugh like I do...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "You're not smiling at all, Palm-chin~~...!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Helios...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll smile.
I'll laugh just like Helios does. I promise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "I'll give it my all for that, I know I can! Because Helios and I are besties forever!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Are we togevver?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
'Cause we're besties forever, aren't we?!
"We're besties forever."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin is...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You two really were
besties for life all along, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
It's been like that right from the start, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Palmer-chin is my bestie for life!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So true☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, congratulations~~!
Helios, come over here too--!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Helios,
looks like it's our turn?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Gotta make some noise, right?!!
—'Cause this is our party!"
